field_principles.arm_configs: Names the Rust PyO3 batch and exact Python fallback batch configurations under one production API.
field_principles.batch_sizes: Makes the amount of independent work per batch explicit instead of implying unmeasured amortization.
field_principles.build_profile: Freezes release/debug, PyO3 ABI, bulk-run symbol, and feature state before any 10x timing claim.
field_principles.cpu_affinity: Shows the one-core and fixed-core placements used for timing.
field_principles.cpu_topology: Separates physical and logical CPU evidence from accelerator or board claims.
field_principles.duration_s: Records real wall-clock artifact construction time for fabrication and reproducibility review.
field_principles.end_to_end_times: Preserves primary latency evidence including serialization, validation, PyO3, allocation, checkpoint, and restart costs.
field_principles.excluded_pair_reasons: Keeps mismatches visible instead of silently relabeling them as speed evidence.
field_principles.experiment: Keeps the numeric experiment identifier explicit for corpus indexing without turning it into a metric.
field_principles.experiment_id: Provides a stable human-readable artifact identity for cross-run provenance.
field_principles.field_principles: Explains why every Exp5739 field exists before a reviewer trusts the JSON shape.
field_principles.fpga_or_tsu_used: Bare false records that no FPGA, TSU, or board participated.
field_principles.gpu_speedup_claimed: Bare false prevents this CPU benchmark from reopening GPU claims.
field_principles.hardware_speedup_claimed: Bare false prevents local CPU software timing from becoming a board or TSU claim.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Starts complete: or blocked: and states whether the strict 10x rule passed or terminally failed.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declares matched CPU Python/Rust batched one-axis sampler benchmarking, not LLM inference or accelerator timing.
field_principles.matched_work_receipts: Proves identical work, energy accounting, samples, transitions, checkpoints, and restart behavior.
field_principles.measured_batch_count: Proves every qualified cell has at least thirty independent measured batches.
field_principles.milestone: Records the conductor milestone without letting milestone status substitute for benchmark evidence.
field_principles.paired_speedup_intervals: Uses adjusted confidence intervals so a 10x claim cannot rest on noisy multiple comparisons.
field_principles.paired_speedup_ratios: Reports paired Python/Rust ratios on identical batches rather than unrelated aggregate means.
field_principles.peak_rss_by_arm: Records memory pressure by arm and thread regime so speed is not traded for hidden RSS growth.
field_principles.phase_times: Preserves bottleneck evidence without subtracting phases from primary timing.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Shows every upstream, build, topology, affinity, thread, and workload gate checked before timing interpretation.
field_principles.preregistered_protocol: Freezes workloads, sizes, batches, seeds, ladders, budgets, checkpoints, warmups, repetitions, quality margins, and 10x null rule.
field_principles.problem_sizes: Makes the 48/96/192 large-size panel explicit, including any infeasible-size blocker.
field_principles.qualified_10x_sizes: Lists only consecutive larger sizes whose adjusted lower confidence bound is at least 10.0.
field_principles.qualified_10x_thread_regime: Names the single thread regime, if any, where the strict consecutive-size 10x rule passed.
field_principles.quality_matched_pair_count: Counts only pairs that passed quality gates before timing intervals.
field_principles.quality_metrics_by_pair: Reports matched quality before any speedup ratio enters a distribution.
field_principles.random_seeds: Records the independent batch seed schedule for exact replay.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Content-addresses the complete artifact after blanking the self-checksum field.
field_principles.run_date: Anchors the local CPU software measurement to the requested 2026-07-20 run date.
field_principles.rust_batched_10x_ready_score: Equals 1.0 only when matched quality and adjusted intervals prove the strict 10x CPU software rule.
field_principles.schema: Names the artifact contract so downstream validators do not infer fields from experiment number alone.
field_principles.software_receipt: Records Python, NumPy, Rust extension, compiler, and source hashes needed to replay the two production arms.
field_principles.software_speedup_claimed: Bare true is allowed only when the strict 10x CPU software rule passes.
field_principles.spec_refs: Binds the artifact to REQ-SAMPLE-5739 and SCENARIO-SAMPLE-5739.
field_principles.thread_receipts: Records matched thread policy for both arms in each regime and discloses implementation asymmetry.
field_principles.throughput_distributions: Reports samples-per-second distributions from the same end-to-end measurements.
field_principles.timing_claimed: Bare true declares this is a timing benchmark, unlike Exp5738 readiness-only evidence.
field_principles.upstream_gate_receipts: Pins Exp5724 null timing evidence and Exp5738 batched backend readiness plus source hashes.
field_principles.warmup_count: Prevents cold-start effects from entering primary measurements.
field_principles.workload_manifest: Lists every size and topology Hamiltonian shared by Python and Rust batch arms.
